		scan=$(mktemp 2>/dev/null) || scan=""

			else

					ts=$(mtime_of "$transcript") || { transcripts_available=no; last_ts=0; break; }
					if ! [[ "$ts" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
						transcripts_available=no; last_ts=0; break
